from pyspark.sql.types import StructType
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, regexp_replace, explode, date_format, to_date, year
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

accountName = 'adlsfhirnonprod'
containerName = 'bronze'
relativePath = '30tb'
linkedServiceName = 'lsadlsfhirnonprod'

sasToken = mssparkutils.credentials.getConnectionStringOrCreds(linkedServiceName)

wasbPath = 'wasbs://%s@%s.blob.core.windows.net/%s' % (containerName, accountName, relativePath)
spark.conf.set('fs.azure.sas.%s.%s.blob.core.windows.net' % (containerName, accountName), sasToken)

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/historic_data/" + relativePath + "/Observation/"
silverPath = "abfss://silver@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + relativePath

observationSchemaFile = bronzePath + "year=2016/"
observationSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(observationSchemaFile).schema

df = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(observationSchema).json(bronzePath)
df = df.withColumn("year", year(to_date(col("issued"))))
df = df.withColumn("month", date_format(to_date(col("issued")), 'MM'))
df = df.withColumn("day", date_format(to_date(col("issued")), 'dd'))

df = df.withColumn("subject",regexp_replace("subject.reference","Patient/","")).withColumn("encounter",regexp_replace("encounter.reference","Encounter/",""))
df = df.withColumnRenamed("id","observation_id")
df = df.withColumnRenamed("subject","patient_id_reference")
df = df.withColumnRenamed("encounter","encounter_id_reference")

df = df.select(
    "observation_id","resourceType","issued","status","patient_id_reference","encounter_id_reference","effectiveDateTime",
    "valueQuantity.code","valueQuantity.system","valueQuantity.unit","valueQuantity.value","valueString","year","month","day").toDF(*(
    "observation_id","resourceType","issued","status","patient_id_reference","encounter_id_reference","effectiveDateTime",
    "valueQuantity_code","valueQuantity_system","valueQuantity_unit","valueQuantity_value","valueString","year","month","day"
    ))

df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Observation_main/")

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/historic_data/" + relativePath + "/Observation/"
silverPath = "abfss://silver@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + relativePath

observationSchemaFile = bronzePath + "year=2016/"
observationSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(observationSchemaFile).schema

df = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(observationSchema).json(bronzePath)
df = df.withColumn("year", year(to_date(col("issued"))))
df = df.withColumn("month", date_format(to_date(col("issued")), 'MM'))
df = df.withColumn("day", date_format(to_date(col("issued")), 'dd'))

df = df.withColumn("subject",regexp_replace("subject.reference","Patient/","")).withColumn("encounter",regexp_replace("encounter.reference","Encounter/",""))
df = df.withColumnRenamed("id","observation_id")
df = df.withColumnRenamed("subject","patient_id_reference")
df = df.withColumnRenamed("encounter","encounter_id_reference")

df = df.select(
    "Observation_id",
    explode(df.category)).toDF(*("observation_id","category"))

df = df.select(
    "observation_id",
    explode(df.category.coding)).toDF(*("observation_id","category"))    

df = df.select("observation_id","category.*","year","month","day").toDF(*(
    "observation_id","category_code","category_display","category_system","year","month","day"))

df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Observation_category/")
